BEFORE:
The Hon'ble JUSTICE MD. NIZAMUDDIN Date : 04TH JULY, 2022.
 Appearance:
 Mr. N. Chowdhury, Adv.
 Mr. P. Bera, Adv.
 ..for the petitioner  Mr. K. K. Maiti, Adv.
 For the respondent No.2 Mr. S. Sanyal, Adv.
Ms. M. Roy, Adv.
For FSSAI The Court: Affidavit-in-opposition filed in Court today be kept on record.

On perusal of the prayers made in the writ petition, it appears that petitioner has made a prayer for direction upon the respondents concerned to send fresh sample of imported goods in question under Bill of Entry No.7939802 dated 05th September, 2019 to any accredited laboratory under the Food Safety and Standard Acts, 2006.

Learned Advocates appearing for the respondent authorities submit that in view of the development taken place during the pendency of the writ petition, no relief can be granted to the petitioner in terms of the prayers ask for in the writ petition since the goods in question is no more in existence.
It has already been disposed of as per the submission of the petitioner and as such the prayer of the petitioner in the writ petition has become infructuous.
